intent: The brief a person hands an agent before it plans: a goal, one-line "done when" checks, optional spend, time and step limits, allowed tools, model and check-in level. Start, then one line.
useWhen: a person sets up a task for an agent before it makes a plan
the result must pass agreed checks, which DoneCheck can mark later
the run needs hard caps on spend, time or steps
doNotUseWhen: the agent already has a plan to approve — PlanReview
a free-text conversation with the agent — Chat
steering a run that is already going — AgentSteering

value.note: { goal, criteria: string[], spendCap?, minutes?, maxSteps?, tools?: string[], model?, autonomy? }. Limits are optional; null means no limit. 1–8 criteria; blank rows do not count.

onChange.note: (next) => void, the whole value on every edit.

tools.note: { value, label }[] for the Tools MultiSelect. Empty hides it.

models.note: ModelPicker models. Omit to hide the picker.

autonomyOptions.note: AutonomyDial stops for the check-in level. Default AUTONOMY_STOPS.

status.note: started folds to one line (goal · checks · cap). error keeps the form and shows a kit Alert.

onStart.note: (value) => void. Start, the one solid primary, disabled until there is a goal and one check; the reason sits beside it.

onSaveDraft.note: (value) => void. Save draft, outline. Omit to hide it.

requirements: the Card is aria-labelledby its title
every control has a label; Done when and Limits are fieldsets with legends
Goal and check errors sit under the control and are linked with aria-describedby
Start is disabled until there is a goal and one check; the reason is text and linked with aria-describedby
starting sets aria-busy and announces in a status region
the started row is named "Started: <goal>" and takes focus if focus was inside
motion is opacity and transform only, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local TaskForm, BriefCard or CriteriaList
Do not let Start run without a goal and at least one check
Start is the one solid primary; Save draft is outline
snippet: <TaskBrief value={brief} onChange={setBrief} tools={[{ value: "read_file", label: "Read files" }]} onStart={start} onSaveDraft={save} />
